Project Manager, Washwood Heath, High Speed Rail
jobs.description:
Our client is recruiting an Project Manager to help bring one of the most significant pieces of new railway infrastructure in the UK into readiness for service.

Want to apply Read all the information about this position below, then hit the apply button.

Based in Birmingham, the role sits at the heart of the Washwood Heath area, covering the Birmingham spur and the main maintenance depot.

The spur is currently at design stage, and the role will grow with the programme as it moves through into construction.

This is a real opportunity to develop construction delivery experience on a programme of genuine scale.This is not a cost control role.

Your day-to-day purpose is to set priorities, coordinate the right people and make sure the right things happen at the right time.

The depot is a critical asset for the railway, and your job is to make sure the work across the Washwood Heath area is integrated, sequenced and moving forward.

You will work across the client team, the contractor and the wider supply chain, holding the connections between disciplines together and keeping delivery on track.You will coordinate multidisciplinary teams across the area, managing the interfaces between projects and making sure risks and issues are identified and resolved before they cause programme delay.

You will lead the development of procurement and specification documents for the overhead works at Washwood Heath, working with technical, commercial and procurement colleagues to make sure the right work goes to market at the right time.

You will manage the project interface with the joint venture responsible for site works and ground remediation, and you will keep the assurance and governance processes moving across the projects you own.

Senior Project Engineers and a programme planner will support you directly.The complexity of this role comes from holding together a large and varied stakeholder group, managing concurrent workstreams at different stages of maturity, and thinking strategically while remaining focused on delivery.What you need to bringYour background is in project or programme delivery on major construction or infrastructure schemes, and you will have been close to the work.

Experience gained in a consultancy environment on a construction project at design stage is directly relevant.

A background as a Civil or Electrical Engineer moving into project management, could both work well here.

What matters is that you understand how projects are developed and delivered, how procurement is structured and sequenced, and how to work across disciplines to keep things moving.You will be comfortable working in a matrix environment, coordinating people who do not report directly to you and influencing decisions across a varied stakeholder group.

You will understand the project management basics, including how to manage an early warning process, how to read and interpret a programme, and how to identify and escalate risk.A degree in project management, engineering, commercial management or a related field is expected, though equivalent practical experience will be considered.Useful to have Experience on HS2 or a comparable major infrastructure or transport programme.

A background that has taken you through more than one stage of a programme lifecycle, from design development through to construction delivery.

Familiarity with P6 or comparable planning tools.

Experience of working through interface issues between civil works and rail systems on a large programme. The role is based in Birmingham, with work focused on the Washwood Heath depot and the Birmingham spur.

Location: Denver, CO. Candidates in Utah or Arizona locations may be considered based on experience.

Employment Type: Full-time regular

How Your Role Will Shape Our Success 

Walker Consultants seeks a motivated Parking and Mobility Project Manager to join in growing our West Region market. We’re seeking an experienced professional with proven project management, business development, and private-sector consulting experience.
The ideal candidate has successfully managed client relationships, delivered consulting services, and developed business within a professional services environment.

As a project manager and consultant, you will lead and support a wide range of projects—from downtown transportation and parking studies to mobility master plans, TDM, shared mobility studies, zero emissions fleet transition plans, micro-mobility plans, bicycle, and pedestrian plans. This role will require developing new business for our planning practice services. We want someone who is curious, motivated, and passionate. 

Why Work With Us?

We offer our employees more than just the basics. Our competitive advantage includes floating holidays that can be used when you want, opportunities to become an employee-owner, paid time to volunteer in your community on projects you’re passionate about, flexibility with hybrid and remote work, and the opportunity to contribute to research that advances our industry. Our firm is supportive of an entrepreneurial spirit, allowing our team to work on projects within our industry that you find personally exciting and fulfilling. As a skilled member of Walker Consultants, you will be given the opportunity to grow and develop your skills surrounded by committed, talented and enthusiastic co-workers.

 Daily responsibilities may include:

client, budget, and schedule management, 

technical development of deliverables,

strategic input and direction of projects,

managing the project team’s technical work on the project,

contributing to the growth of our services,

developing and expanding market growth in areas in which you are a subject matter expert,

presenting our work to our clients, elected officials, and other community members,

industry involvement with professional organizations,

developing business to support the growth of the practice

About Walker Consultants

Walker Consultants is a financially stable, 100% employee-owned professional services firm that serves public- and private-sector clients by providing industry-leading transportation, transit, mobility, and parking planning-related services. We help provide access to and maintain the built environment. Because our firm is diverse in our services, well-established, and sought after, we work on leading-edge projects that shape our communities. In addition to contributing in your area of subject matter, you have opportunities to learn and become involved in other areas of our practice. 

From small towns to large urban metros and regional agencies, we help our clients build communities where people want to live, work, and have fun. For every project, we develop creative strategies that put people first and are rooted in data aligned with overall goals for transportation, economic development, climate, and land use. We are focused on the future, and our plans and policies are shaped by technology, data, and infrastructure that maximize today’s investments for what’s next.

As part of our Denver office, you will be an integral part of growing our West Region while supporting our national group of experts and collaborating with planners, engineers, and urban designers across the country to serve our clients. We cover a large geographic area, so there is plenty of opportunity to travel.

You’ll have an opportunity to test ideas, shape policy directly, and see your plans implemented. At Walker, we go beyond planning—we are implementers at the forefront of real change.

What Sets Us Apart? 

Walker is 100% employee-owned! Join us and become part of a company where you have a direct stake in our success. 

What makes this opportunity even more exciting is our true ownership program. At Walker, our equity-based model allows shareholders to directly benefit from the firm’s success, rather than a traditional ESOP that focuses only on stock appreciation. It’s a unique chance to grow with a company that values its people. 

Responsibilities of the Role 

Self-motivation and an eagerness to learn new things are a must

Working within a collaborative, motivated team with a growth mindset

Managing small and mid-size transportation, parking and mobility projects for public-sector and private-sector clients, leveraging prior consulting experience to deliver high-quality client service, technical expertise, and project outcomes

Effective written and verbal communication skills and the ability to connect with a broad range of clients

Ability to manage the financial and schedule elements of the project

Maintaining strong relationships in the industry and with our clients. 

Lending skill and expertise to larger transportation, parking and mobility projects led by senior staff, with a focus on parking and curbside management, operation and technology, data collection and analysis, and transportation planning

Leading and/or supporting community engagement, awareness and collaboration efforts in line with our national community engagement policies and practices

Preparing and presenting technical reports, memos, presentations, and other documents in a way that represents our work well and is digestible to a wide range of audiences, from CEOs and City Councils to non-technical members of our community. 

Assisting with marketing activities, including writing proposals and participating in interviews

Business development activities by identifying leads through your network and helping to respond to RFP/RFQ’s

Proactively meeting with new or repeat clients to generate new business. 

Participating in networking activities and representing our firm at local and regional industry meetings and conferences. 

Other duties as assigned

Qualifications and Requirements

5 or more years of experience managing projects (schedule, budget, client relationships, deliverables). 

5 or more years of experience in parking, mobility, curbside, and/or transportation planning

Education Requirements: Accredited bachelor’s degree or higher in appropriate fields of study, such as urban planning or transportation. 

Demonstrated excellent written, verbal, and critical thinking skills

Ability to analyze large data sets and provide technical analysis

Demonstrated proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint. 

Ability to travel

5 or more years of experience working in a private-sector consulting or professional services environment, including responsibility for client management, project delivery, and business development

Required Experience:
Candidates must have previous experience working in a private-sector consulting or professional services firm. Experience solely within a public agency, municipality, or owner/client organization without consulting experience will not meet the minimum qualifications for this role.

jobs.description:
Job Overview

We are seeking an experienced and motivated Infection Prevention Business Project Manager to join our Infection Prevention (IP) team. This is an exciting opportunity to lead on high-impact programmes that support patient safety, quality improvement, and organisational performance.

The post holder will lead and deliver complex projects and programmes across the Infection Prevention service, working collaboratively with clinical, operational and managerial teams. You will play a key role in shaping service development, driving innovation, and ensuring effective implementation of IP strategies aligned with organisational and national priorities.

The ability to speak Welsh is desirable for this post; Welsh and/or English speakers are equally welcome to apply.

Main duties of the job

Lead the planning, delivery, and evaluation of complex IPC projects and programmes
Analyse performance, capacity, and demand data to inform decision-making and service improvements
Develop and implement new models of working to enhance infection prevention practices
Work collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams to support integrated service delivery
Contribute to policy development and ensure effective implementation across services
Monitor project outcomes, risks, and benefits, ensuring delivery within agreed timelines and resources
Support service improvement initiatives

Working for our organisation

If you relish a challenge, have a passion to help others or simply fancy a fresh start, then Betsi Cadwaladr University Health Board (BCUHB) North Wales, has all the right ingredients. The largest health organisation in Wales, providing a full range of primary, community, mental health, acute and elective hospital services for a population of around 700,000, across North Wales . Join our team and get the support you need, in line with our Organisational Values and ‘Proud to Lead’ competence framework.

Enjoy being part of working with engaged leadership at all levels, and be assured we are committed to promoting equality and diversity, and are proud to welcome applicants under the “Disability Confident Employer” scheme.

Please check your email account regularly. Successful applicants will receive all recruitment related correspondence via the email account registered on the application form.

Applications may be submitted in Welsh. Applications submitted in Welsh will not be treated less favourably than an application submitted in English.

Detailed Job Description And Main Responsibilities

The Infection Prevention Business and Project Manager provides specialist business, programme, and project management to support the Infection Prevention and Control (IPC) agenda.

The post holder will be required to plan, coordinate, and deliver a range of IPC‑related programmes, projects, audits, campaigns, and improvement activities that support the prevention, surveillance, and reduction of healthcare‑associated infections (HCAIs).

The role supports IPC clinical leadership and senior managers by ensuring IPC workstreams are effectively governed, delivered, monitored, and reported, contributing to patient safety, regulatory assurance, and continuous quality improvement.

The post holder will operate with a high degree of autonomy within agreed organisational priorities, governance frameworks, and escalation processes.

Person specification

Qualifications

Essential criteria

Degree or equivalent of knowledge
ILM Management level 4 or equivalent
Current knowledge of project management and it application

Desirable criteria

Evidence of managing and leading complex projects
Evidence of dealing with complex data and analysis

Experiance

Essential Criteria

These roles focus on supporting international trade transactions, managing trade finance documentation, coordinating banking operations, and ensuring that trade-related activities are processed accurately and efficiently. Trade Finance Specialists are responsible for supporting trade finance products and services, including letters of credit, documentary collections, bank guarantees, and other trade-related financial instruments.
